decisions.reason: The mitred lever family is a multi-model line with tooling and finishing investment, and it fits the firm's coordinated product-family strategy, so management keeps it even though it has received only modest website exposure.
The multifunctional handle was promoted to its own page in 2024, a visible public commitment in line with the barrier-free direction, which makes dropping it very unlikely.

This lever line carries sunk development costs and remains listed on the website, so management will persist despite its low visibility, though it is the most exposed of the four given that sibling line A was already removed.
The FSB 1289 collection has strong public commitment, with dedicated pages and German Design and iF awards, and it is a flagship the firm will defend and extend.
